results.evidence: In duplicateInsight, `if (redirectToInsight) { sceneLayoutLogic.findMounted()?.actions.setScenePanelOpen(false) ... }` closes the panel as part of the duplication flow. I can't see sceneLayoutLogic, so I'm assuming setScenePanelOpen exists and closes the overlay.
The same block still calls `router.actions.push(urls.insightEdit(newInsight.short_id))` right after the close. `lemonToast.success('Insight duplicated')` runs before it.
The close is unconditional for redirects: there is no check for overlay versus docked presentation. Whether a docked panel stays open depends on sceneLayoutLogic internals that aren't shown.

Both entry points now call `urls.resourceTransfer('Insight', insight.id!, insight.short_id)`. The URL builder adds `?source=<shortId>` via `combineUrl(..., sourceShortId ? { source: sourceShortId } : {})`.
`sourceResourceUrl` for Insight returns `urls.insightView(sourceShortId as InsightShortId)` when `searchParams.source` is present, and the source comes from the router search params.

Dashboard and Survey still use `urls.dashboard(resourceId)` and `urls.survey(resourceId)`. `resourceTransfer` adds a query param only when `sourceShortId` is provided, and only insight callers pass it.

The card gets `@container`, and the content div uses `flex flex-col @md:flex-row`. The illustration is wrapped in `hidden @md:block shrink-0`, so it is hidden and the layout stacks below the @md container width.
